body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces the final gate artifacts for the full data governance process of subject code 9709, including the final gate JSON, a markdown readback, validator results, and handoff documents for both the V1 minimal trusted method-set and long-tail unserved workstreams. The review feedback suggests sorting the source_artifacts array lexicographically by path in the final gate JSON to prevent diff churn and maintain consistency.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
